comment: Which GCP billing account CHIA's opencode spend is attributed to, by time. opencode's DB does not record the GCP project a session billed (session.model holds only providerID/modelID), so attribution is by cutover time: every google-vertex session created at or after cutover_ms is counted against CHIA2026. See spend.py.

current.cutover_event: chia.env's GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT switched from test-adrs to chia2026-tinytpu

previous.billing_account_name: My Billing Account (general, shared with unrelated projects)
